posts.cooked:
[Split from K.N.Y.F.E.'s Overdo It - incredibly underwhelming]

Man! If only there was an easy way to get text from another post, having it clearly labeled as such, with even the username listed, so that way everyone would know who and what folks are responding to. I think I should let someone know that this is a feature that the forums really needs.
